crowd.buyer: Online shoppers, then local shops that stock makers

off_season.play: Use the quiet weeks to shoot photos, fix product pages and pitch local shops for spring.

crowd.note: First orders usually come from people who know you, then from search and shops that carry you. Ads cost money before you know what sells.
not_yet: Don't order 500 units before 25 people have seen the product and its price.
Don't pay for ads before your product page and price are right.
Don't pay for apps or a custom theme before your first 10 orders.

partners.label: Gift shops and boutiques
partners.why: look for local, handmade things to give
partners.ask: look at a few samples and a line sheet, on wholesale or consignment terms that suit you
partners.give: point my followers and email list to your shop once my pieces are on your shelf

partners.label: Markets and craft fairs
partners.why: come looking for things made nearby
partners.ask: tell me how to apply for a vendor table at an upcoming market
partners.give: share the market date with my followers and list

partners.label: Craft, art and stationery shops
partners.why: like to see work by local makers
partners.ask: look at a few samples for a shelf or a local makers corner
partners.give: point my followers and email list to your shop once my pieces are in

partners.label: Independent bookshops
partners.why: pick up a small gift at the counter
partners.ask: look at a few samples for your gift table, on wholesale or consignment
partners.give: point my followers and email list to your shop once my pieces are in

partners.label: Independent cafes
partners.why: notice local things on the counter while they wait
partners.ask: keep a few pieces on a small shelf or the counter, on consignment
partners.give: send people your way when I post where to find my pieces
